lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a non-uniform grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot alignments to create a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient between the illuminated dorsal surface and the shadowed lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible attached to the ventral-lateral region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
